item.title: Dolly Parton credited 'town tramp' for her signature style | 60 Minutes Archive
item.description: In a 2009 interview, Dolly Parton discussed her iconic look and how being underestimated aided her business success. She has passed away.

item.title: Country music legend Dolly Parton dies at 80
item.description: Dolly Parton built a legendary career over six decades as a Grammy-winning musician, actress, and entrepreneur, also known for her charitable work.

item.title: Canada imposes retaliatory tariffs up to 50% on U.S. goods
item.description: Canada announced tariffs as high as 50% on hundreds of U.S. products on Tuesday.
